consumers.evidence: README defines one multi-file attachment entry, native Codex image delivery with a local-path fallback, size limits, local-only storage, and cleanup behavior.
Structured decision records the unified attachment contract and keeps native general-file queue support and very large uploads deferred.
Current sources do not reduce the product to an image uploader, apply an extension whitelist, or create a cloud file library.
Implementation commit 3c97bac includes multi-file parsing, content-based image detection, queue image fallback, local-path delivery, 24-hour cleanup, UI selection limits, and regression coverage.
